product_implementation.hosting_product: Jura Trace v0.9.0-rc14 (Tauri desktop app, Rust)

per_format_evidence_structure.jura_trace_verify_response.json: PRIMARY — full raw JSON response from Jura Trace's verify endpoint, showing the validator ran end-to-end and read the manifest correctly.
per_format_evidence_structure.jura_signed.<ext>: The file Jura Trace produced. Submit this to your own validator for independent review.
per_format_evidence_structure.source.<ext>: Unsigned source image used for each format conversion.
per_format_evidence_structure.c2patool_selfqa.json: Internal QA only — our own cross-check. Not intended as programme evidence.

explicit_note_for_programme_reviewer: The primary evidence for validator conformance is the jura_trace_verify_response.json files — each is the unedited HTTP response body from Jura Trace's REST API verify endpoint, with a schema distinct from c2patool's (camelCase, detectorsRun, deepfakeResult, etc.). Please run your own validator against the jura_signed.<ext> files; the c2patool_selfqa.json files are included only as internal reproducibility artefacts and not as substitutes for programme-side validation.
